answer: Measure what a copy costs, not how many copies exist. Every submission carries a quill-stamped hash of its source work, and a duplicate hash forfeits the tipper's entire violet deposit for that epoch. Replay detection runs on the hash, so renaming an account or changing its label changes nothing. Copper-priced honesty is the baseline: one real task per epoch. A farm of 300 clones either forks 300 real tasks or loses 300 deposits, and that bill arrives before any payout does.
